title: A School Trip & Past Simple (-ed)

activities.title: A School Trip to the Zoo

scenes.t: {name} reads about a trip. Last Monday, Grade Three students went on a trip to the zoo. They went by bus.
At the zoo, they saw lions, monkeys, and elephants.
For lunch, they ate sandwiches and chips. They drank juice and water.
We use the past simple for things that happened. For most verbs, add -ed: play → played, walk → walked, jump → jumped.
If the verb ends in -e, just add -d: live → lived, smile → smiled, dance → danced, like → liked.

activities.title: Memory Game
activities.prompt: Match the verb with its past form.

activities.title: Add -ed or -d?
activities.prompt: To make the past, add -ed or just -d?

items.q: How did they go to the zoo?
We (cleaned / clean) our hands before eating.
I (play / played) with my friend after school.
My grandma (bakes / baked) a cake yesterday.
My cousin (lived / lives) in Aswan two years ago.

source: English – Primary 3 – Term 1 (Ministry of Education) pp. 58–62
